subject: english
question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

Large-scale hunting scenes and slaugter of wild animals is a heinous crime.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"slaugter"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"slaughter"**.
 
• **Meaning of "slaughter"**: The killing of animals for food or the violent killing of a large number of people. (वध)
 
 
• **Example:** The **slaughter** of innocent civilians during the war was heartbreaking.
 
 
 
• **"Slaugter"** is not a word in English, and it does not have a meaning. The correct word is **"slaughter"**.
 
 
• **Example:** The butcher prepared the** slaughter **of the cattle early in the morning.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Slaugter**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Heinous** (घृणित): Utterly odious or wicked.

 
 
• **Example:** The criminal was punished for his heinous crimes.
 
 
 
• **Scenes** (दृश्य): A part of a play, movie, story, etc., in which a particular action or activity occurs.
 
 
• **Example:** The movie has beautiful scenes of the countryside.
 
 
 
• **Hunting** (शिकार): The activity or sport of chasing and killing wild animals.
 
 
• **Example:** Hunting is prohibited in national parks.
